title: Rina and the Night Market
blurb: Rina and her grandfather go to the pasar malam. Kakek wants to buy something special, but what is it?

chapters.title: The Market Lights
chapters.text:
Every Saturday night, a market opens near Rina's house. It is called the pasar malam. There are colourful lights on every stall.

Rina goes with her grandfather. She calls him Kakek. He holds a big blue bag. "Tonight I will buy something special," says Kakek. He will not say what it is.

Rina smells sweet banana fritters. She hears a drum and a happy song. A man sells red balloons. Rina would love a balloon, but she does not ask.

chapters.title: The Lost Purse
chapters.text:
Kakek stops at a small stall. A man sells little boats made from coconut shells. "These are the special things," says Kakek. "I will buy two. One is for you and one is for me."

He looks in his bag, but his purse is not there! Kakek looks very sad.

"Do not worry, Kakek," says Rina. "We can walk back and look." They go slowly along the same path. Rina looks under a table. She looks near the drum.

At last they come to the balloon man. He smiles and holds up a brown purse. "I found this on the ground," he says. "I kept it safe for you."

chapters.title: The Best Surprise
chapters.text:
"Thank you," says Kakek. "You are very kind." He gives the balloon man a big smile.

Then Kakek buys the two coconut boats. He pays for a red balloon too. "This is for you, Rina," he says. "You waited so kindly tonight. You did not ask for anything."

Rina is so happy. She hugs Kakek tightly.

On Sunday, they go to the pond near the house. Rina puts her boat on the water. It floats! The red balloon bobs above it. "Next Saturday, we will go to the market again," says Kakek.
